docket_entries.description: AMENDED PETITION FOR FORFEITURE IN REM
STIPULATION TO JUDGMENT FILED BY PEOPLE OF THE STATE OF CALIFORNIA TAYLOR, QUINDENA

THE COURT ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: JUDGMENT OF FORFEITURE AND DISPOSITION PURSUANT TO STIPULATION. RESPONDENT PROPERTY SUBJECT TO DISPOSITION: $250.00 BE RELEASED TO CLAIMANT RONNIE COLLINS. RESPONDENT PROPERTY SUBJECT TO DISPOSITION: $250.00 BE RELEASED TO CLAIMANT QUINDENA TAYLOR. RESPONDENT PROPERTY SUBJECT TO DISPOSITION: $896.00 PLUS INTEREST SINCE DATE OF DEPOSIT IS HEREBY DECLARED FORFEITED PURSUANT TO H&S 11470 ET SEQ AND DISPOSED OF AS PROVIDED BY H&S 11489. ANY RIGHTS TO APPEAL OR FURTHER LITIGATION CONCERNING THE SEIZURE OR RESOLUTION IS MUTUALLY WAIVED BY BOTH PARTIES. PARTIES SHALL BEAR THEIR COSTS OF SUIT AND ATTORNEY FEES. SEE SCANNED DOCUMENT
